text: This chapter builds on the information from previous chapters to explore the practical application of the science of hypertrophy training. Considerations for exercise selection are discussed from a biomechanical standpoint with a focus on how movements can be synergistically varied to ensure complete muscular development. A discussion of program design follows, detailing the nuances of manipulating program variables over the course of a periodized training cycle to maximize the hypertrophic response by proper management of stimulus and fatigue. Numerous examples are provided throughout the chapter to illustrate the practical application of relevant concepts.
